policy_notes: High autonomy is opt-in at promotion command; does not mean unattended remote execution.
New skills require pinned provenance, single-file Markdown, zero screening flags, sandbox rehearsal and independent evidence review.
An allowlisted publisher is not a safety certification. Never execute code fetched from discovery.
Scripts, hooks, network tools, accounts, credential handling, permissions expansion and deployments require separate explicit authority.
GitHub Actions are not assumed available. Test locally; absent verification remains unknown.
